verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a full REST API (OpenAPI spec) for programmatic instance creation and management, cloud-init for launch-time workload configuration, and dashboard-level monitoring (Grafana/DCGM, Slurm daemon health, usage page), which covers most of the provision→run→monitor lifecycle without a console. However there is no first-party CLI, and MCP support exists only as a third-party/unofficial project built by a community developer rather than an official Lambda offering, and explicit API documentation for instance teardown/termination is not directly cited. missing for 10: official CLI, first-party MCP server, explicit terminate/teardown API docs, per-instance workload health/status API beyond dashboards.
